gloss: to crowd; to flock; to swarm

definitions.gloss: to crowd together; to flock; to swarm; to gather in groups
definitions.explanation: For animals or people to gather together in large numbers. When used about people, it can carry a slightly negative nuance of mindlessly clustering together.

examples.japanese: {観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{人気|にんき}スポットに{群|む}れる。
{池|いけ}に{餌|えさ}をまくと、{鯉|こい}がたくさん{群|む}れてきた。
examples.english: When I tossed feed into the pond, lots of koi came swarming over.

notes: An ichidan verb ({群|む}れない / {群|む}れます / {群|む}れて). Related noun: {群|む}れ (a group, flock, herd). Not to be confused with the homophone {蒸|む}れる (to become stuffy/humid). When used about people, {群|む}れる can imply a lack of individuality or mindless following, as in {群|む}れるのが{嫌|きら}い (I don't like running with the crowd).
